subtopics.title: Difficulty of Evaluating Intelligent Outputs
subtopics.summary: Explains why evaluating foundation models is harder than traditional ML, as human evaluators struggle to judge high-quality, complex outputs like PhD-level solutions or coherent summaries without deep domain knowledge.

subtopics.title: Comparative vs. Absolute Performance
subtopics.summary: Discusses the shift from measuring absolute performance to using comparative evaluation to rank models against each other when absolute ground truth is difficult to establish.

subtopics.title: Lack of Standardization and Quality Control
subtopics.summary: Addresses the absence of universal standards and quality control mechanisms in foundation model evaluation, making results hard to compare across different studies and providers.

subtopics.title: Scalability Bottlenecks in Evaluation
subtopics.summary: Covers the challenges of scaling evaluation processes due to the high cost and time required for human annotation and testing of large generative outputs.
